4000.name: Garry's Mod
4000.short_description: Garry's Mod is a physics sandbox. There aren't any predefined aims or goals. We give you the tools and leave you to play.

105600.name: Terraria
105600.short_description: Dig, fight, explore, build! Nothing is impossible in this action-packed adventure game. Four Pack also available!

108600.name: Project Zomboid
108600.short_description: Project Zomboid is the ultimate in zombie survival. Alone or in MP: you loot, build, craft, fight, farm and fish in a struggle to survive. A hardcore RPG skillset, a vast map, massively customisable sandbox and a cute tutorial raccoon await the unwary. So how will you die? All it takes is a bite..

200210.name: Realm of the Mad God Exalt
200210.short_description: Embark on an exhilarating journey into the pixelated Realm of the Mad God! Join, an action-packed, free-to-play MMO bullet hell game. Discover a world with danger, challenges, and hidden treasures as you battle through waves of enemies. Team up with players and conquer dungeons to become a legend!

220200.name: Kerbal Space Program
220200.short_description: In Kerbal Space Program, take charge of the space program for the alien race known as the Kerbals. You have access to an array of parts to assemble fully-functional spacecraft that flies (or doesn’t) based on realistic aerodynamic and orbital physics.

227300.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2
227300.short_description: Travel across Europe as king of the road, a trucker who delivers important cargo across impressive distances! With dozens of cities to explore, your endurance, skill and speed will all be pushed to their limits.

242760.name: The Forest
242760.short_description: As the lone survivor of a passenger jet crash, you find yourself in a mysterious forest battling to stay alive against a society of cannibalistic mutants. Build, explore, survive in this terrifying first person survival horror simulator.

244210.name: Assetto Corsa
244210.short_description: Assetto Corsa v1.16 introduces the new "Laguna Seca" laser-scanned track, 7 new cars among which the eagerly awaited Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio! Check the changelog for further info!

250900.name: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
250900.short_description: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth is a randomly generated action RPG shooter with heavy Rogue-like elements. Following Isaac on his journey players will find bizarre treasures that change Isaac’s form giving him super human abilities and enabling him to fight off droves of mysterious creatures, discover secrets and fight his way to safety.

252490.name: Rust
252490.short_description: The only aim in Rust is to survive. Everything wants you to die - the island’s wildlife, other inhabitants, the environment, and other survivors. Do whatever it takes to last another night.

262060.name: Darkest Dungeon®
262060.short_description: Darkest Dungeon is a challenging gothic roguelike turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring. Recruit, train, and lead a team of flawed heroes against unimaginable horrors, stress, disease, and the ever-encroaching dark. Can you keep your heroes together when all hope is lost?

264710.name: Subnautica
264710.short_description: Descend into the depths of an alien underwater world filled with wonder and peril. Craft equipment, pilot submarines and out-smart wildlife to explore lush coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems, and more - all while trying to survive.

268910.name: Cuphead
268910.short_description: Cuphead is a classic run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Inspired by cartoons of the 1930s, the visuals and audio are painstakingly created with the same techniques of the era, i.e. traditional hand drawn cel animation, watercolor backgrounds, and original jazz recordings.

275850.name: No Man's Sky
275850.short_description: No Man's Sky is a game about exploration and survival in an infinite procedurally generated universe.

282140.name: SOMA
282140.short_description: From the creators of Amnesia: The Dark Descent comes SOMA, a sci-fi horror game set below the waves of the Atlantic ocean. Struggle to survive a hostile world that will make you question your very existence.

285900.name: Gang Beasts
285900.short_description: Gang Beasts is a silly multiplayer party game with surly gelatinous characters, brutal slapstick fight sequences, and absurd hazardous environments, set in the mean streets of Beef City.

286160.name: Tabletop Simulator
286160.short_description: Tabletop Simulator is the only simulator where you can let your aggression out by flipping the table! There are no rules to follow: just you, a physics sandbox, and your friends. Make your own online board games or play the thousands of community created mods. Unlimited gaming possibilities!

291550.name: Brawlhalla
291550.short_description: An epic platform fighter for up to 8 players online or local. Try casual free-for-alls, ranked matches, or invite friends to a private room. And it's free! Play cross-platform with millions of players on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android & Steam! Frequent updates. Over sixty Legends.

292000.name: No More Room in Hell 2
292000.short_description: No More Room in Hell 2 is an intense 8 player zombie shooter. Overcome the endless undead. Avoid infection. Survive hell together.

293760.name: Automation - The Car Company Tycoon Game
293760.short_description: Make your dream cars a reality with Automation’s unparalleled car and engine design tools. Gain a competitive edge through smart engineering and business decisions to help you build an automotive empire. Will you become an industry leader, or just a footnote in automotive history?

294100.name: RimWorld
294100.short_description: A sci-fi colony sim driven by an intelligent AI storyteller. Generates stories by simulating psychology, ecology, gunplay, melee combat, climate, biomes, diplomacy, interpersonal relationships, art, medicine, trade, and more.

312520.name: Rain World
312520.short_description: You are a nomadic slugcat, both predator and prey in a broken ecosystem. Grab your spear and brave the industrial wastes, hunting enough food to survive, but be wary— other, bigger creatures have the same plan... and slugcats look delicious.

313120.name: Stranded Deep
313120.short_description: Take the role of a plane crash survivor stranded somewhere in the Pacific Ocean. Come face to face with some of the most life threatening scenarios that will result in a different experience each time you play. Scavenge. Discover. Survive.

322170.name: Geometry Dash
322170.short_description: Jump and fly your way through danger in this rhythm-based action platformer!

322330.name: Don't Starve Together
322330.short_description: Fight, Farm, Build and Explore Together in the standalone multiplayer expansion to the uncompromising wilderness survival game, Don't Starve.

346110.name: ARK: Survival Evolved
346110.short_description: Stranded on the shores of a mysterious island, you must learn to survive. Use your cunning to kill or tame the primeval creatures roaming the land, and encounter other players to survive, dominate... and escape!

367520.name: Hollow Knight
367520.short_description: Forge your own path in Hollow Knight! An epic action adventure through a vast ruined kingdom of insects and heroes. Explore twisting caverns, battle tainted creatures and befriend bizarre bugs, all in a classic, hand-drawn 2D style.

371970.name: Barony
371970.short_description: Barony is the premier first-person roguelike with cooperative play! Adventure alone, or gather a party with iconic and unusual RPG classes to face off against the brutal dungeons. Test your resourcefulness, wits, and friendships, on your quest to lift the evil lich's curse!

376210.name: The Isle
376210.short_description: Experience fierce open world survival gameplay as you attempt to stay alive on an unforgiving island inhabited by dinosaurs! Hunt. Grow. Survive.

391540.name: Undertale
391540.short_description: UNDERTALE! The RPG game where you don't have to destroy anyone.

413150.name: Stardew Valley
413150.short_description: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?

427520.name: Factorio
427520.short_description: Factorio is a game about building and creating automated factories to produce items of increasing complexity, within an infinite 2D world. Use your imagination to design your factory, combine simple elements into ingenious structures, and finally protect it from the creatures who don't really like you.

433340.name: Slime Rancher
433340.short_description: Slime Rancher is the tale of Beatrix LeBeau, a plucky, young rancher who sets out for a life a thousand light years away from Earth on the ‘Far, Far Range’ where she tries her hand at making a living wrangling slimes.

436780.name: Tavern Keeper 🍻
436780.short_description: From the creators of Game Dev Tycoon comes Tavern Keeper 🍻, a cosy-chaotic management sim, featuring a powerful decoration sandbox and a magical storybook RPG!

457140.name: Oxygen Not Included
457140.short_description: Oxygen Not Included is a space-colony simulation game. Deep inside an alien space rock your industrious crew will need to master science, overcome strange new lifeforms, and harness incredible space tech to survive, and possibly, thrive.

499170.name: Order of the Sinking Star
499170.short_description: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a massive puzzle adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.

504230.name: Celeste
504230.short_description: Help Madeline survive her inner demons on her journey to the top of Celeste Mountain, in this super-tight platformer from the creators of TowerFall. Brave hundreds of hand-crafted challenges, uncover devious secrets, and piece together the mystery of the mountain.

508440.name: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator
508440.short_description: Be the leader of wobblers from ancient lands, spooky places, and fantasy worlds. Watch them fight in simulations made with the wobbliest physics system ever created, make your own wobblers in the unit creator and send your army off to fight your friends in multiplayer.

526870.name: Satisfactory
526870.short_description: Satisfactory is a first-person open-world factory building game with a dash of exploration and combat. Play alone or with friends, explore an alien planet, create multi-story factories, and enter conveyor belt heaven!

581320.name: Insurgency: Sandstorm
581320.short_description: Insurgency: Sandstorm is a hardcore tactical FPS built on lethal close-quarters combat and ruthless intensity. Every bullet count, every step matters, and teamwork is your only path to survival in the brutality of modern warfare.

588650.name: Dead Cells
588650.short_description: Dead Cells is a roguelite, metroidvania inspired, action-platformer. You'll explore a sprawling, ever-changing castle... assuming you’re able to fight your way past its keepers in 2D souls-lite combat. No checkpoints. Kill, die, learn, repeat.

620980.name: Beat Saber
620980.short_description: Slash the beats, get moving, and experience the world's most popular VR rhythm game!* Duck, dodge, and flow through 300+ handcrafted songs from artists like Coldplay, Imagine Dragons, and Metallica. Play solo, compete online, or pass the headset at your next party. Jump in with 60+ songs included!

627690.name: Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms

629730.name: Blade and Sorcery
629730.short_description: Blade & Sorcery is a built-for-VR medieval fantasy with full physics driven melee, ranged and magic combat. Become a powerful warrior, ranger or sorcerer and devastate your enemies.

632360.name: Risk of Rain 2
632360.short_description: Escape a chaotic alien planet by fighting through hordes of frenzied monsters – with your friends, or on your own. Combine loot in surprising ways and master each character until you become the havoc you feared upon your first crash landing.

641990.name: The Escapists 2
641990.short_description: Craft, Steal, Brawl and Escape! It’s time to bust out of the toughest prisons in the world as you return to the life of an inmate in The Escapists 2, now with multiplayer! Have you got what it takes to escape?

646570.name: Slay the Spire
646570.short_description: We fused card games and roguelikes together to make the best single player deckbuilder we could. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, and Slay the Spire!

648800.name: Raft
648800.short_description: Raft™ throws you and your friends into an epic oceanic adventure! Alone or together, players battle to survive a perilous voyage across a vast sea! Gather debris, scavenge reefs and build your own floating home, but be wary of the man-eating sharks!

690830.name: Foundation
690830.short_description: Foundation is a grid-less, laidback medieval city-building game with a focus on organic development, monument construction and resource management.

739630.name: Phasmophobia
739630.short_description: Phasmophobia is a 4 player online co-op psychological horror. Paranormal activity is on the rise and it’s up to you and your team to use all the ghost-hunting equipment at your disposal in order to gather as much evidence as you can.

747660.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach

753640.name: Outer Wilds
753640.short_description: Named Game of the Year 2019 by Giant Bomb, Polygon, Eurogamer, and The Guardian, Outer Wilds is a critically-acclaimed and award-winning open world mystery about a solar system trapped in an endless time loop.

824270.name: KovaaK's
824270.short_description: Master your aim with KovaaK’s, the world’s best aim trainer. With over 200,000 scenarios, playlists and more! Embrace total customization, including a map editor and game physics. More than just a trainer, it’s a dynamic, community-driven platform that elevates your gameplay.

880940.name: Pummel Party
880940.short_description: Pummel Party is a 4-8 player online and local-multiplayer party game. Pummel friends or AI using a wide array of absurd items in the board mode and compete to destroy friendships in the unique collection of minigames.

881100.name: Noita
881100.short_description: Noita is a magical action roguelite set in a world where every pixel is physically simulated. Fight, explore, melt, burn, freeze and evaporate your way through the procedurally generated world using spells you've created yourself.

892970.name: Valheim
892970.short_description: A collaborative exploration and survival game for 1-10 players, set in a procedurally generated afterlife inspired by Viking culture. Battle, build, and conquer your way to a saga worthy of Odin’s patronage!

899770.name: Last Epoch
899770.short_description: Uncover the Past, Reforge the Future. Ascend into one of 15 mastery classes and explore dangerous dungeons, hunt epic loot, craft legendary weapons, and wield the power of over a hundred transformative skill trees. Last Epoch is being developed by a team of passionate Action RPG enthusiasts.

1013320.name: Firestone – Idle Clicker Online RPG
1013320.short_description: Your heroes never stop fighting. Build an unstoppable team in a fantasy idle RPG with AFK progression and offline rewards. Collect heroes and powerful gear, master formations, defeat epic bosses, and return to bigger rewards and endless incremental growth.

1030300.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong
1030300.short_description: Discover a vast, haunted kingdom in Hollow Knight: Silksong! Explore, fight and survive as you ascend to the peak of a land ruled by silk and song.

1040200.name: Crime Scene Cleaner
1040200.short_description: Once you get tangled with the mob, you will forever be a part of the mob. At least they pay a decent salary and all you have to do is clean up after their dirty work, but you know what you’re doing. So clean crime scenes, earn as much money as you can, and get ready for the next mission.

1084600.name: My Time at Sandrock
1084600.short_description: Travel to the desert community of Sandrock and take on the role of a fledgling Builder. Use your trusty toolset to gather resources, construct machines, and turn your run-down workshop into a well-oiled production facility to save the town from the jaws of economic ruin!

1118520.name: Paralives
1118520.short_description: Paralives is a life simulation game about building homes, lives and bonds. Through both hardship and success, where will your story take you?

1133870.name: Space Engineers 2
1133870.short_description: Space Engineers 2 is a playable Early Access Alpha sandbox focused on engineering, exploration, and colonization in a fully destructible universe. Design and build ships, stations, and planetary bases while uncovering the story of Miro and Ivan Sokol. Help shape the future of the Almagest system.

1145350.name: Hades II
1145350.short_description: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.

1158160.name: Coral Island
1158160.short_description: Coral Island is a vibrant, laid-back farm sim reimagined with multiplayer! Experience enchanting island life at your own pace: farm with friends, nurture animals, build relationships, hang out with a diverse cast of characters, and dive into the magical Merfolk Kingdom.

1159690.name: Voidtrain
1159690.short_description: Become a crew member of an Interdimensional Express Train! Discover a new world full of mysterious creatures, enemies and places. Upgrade and customize your train, gather new materials and build better weapons. Play solo or online сo-op with up to 4 people.

1167630.name: Teardown
1167630.short_description: Prepare the perfect heist in a fully destructible, simulated voxel world. Tear down walls with vehicles or use explosives to create your own shortcuts. Shape the environment to your advantage in the most creative ways you can imagine. Play solo or with up to 12 players in multiplayer.

1203620.name: Enshrouded
1203620.short_description: Enshrouded is a solo and co-op survival action RPG where your freedom and creativity come first. Conquer the Shroud, a corrupting fog devouring the kingdom of Embervale: explore a handcrafted world full of secrets, forge your hero your way, and build anything, anywhere in a fully terraformable land.

1206560.name: WorldBox - God Simulator
1206560.short_description: WorldBox is the ULTIMATE god simulator and sandbox game. A petri dish for your fantasy civilizations. Create your own world or destroy it using many powers. Watch civilizations grow, form kingdoms, colonize new lands, sail to far continents, wars to ignite, empires to fall and towns to burn!

1215940.name: Forever Ago
1215940.short_description: Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption in this single-player road trip adventure.

1217060.name: Gunfire Reborn
1217060.short_description: Gunfire Reborn is a level-based adventure game featuring FPS, Roguelite and RPG. Players can control heroes with various abilities to experience diverse Build gameplay, use various weapons to explore procedurally-generated levels. You can play the game alone, or join 4-player coop.

1243830.name: Overcooked! All You Can Eat
1243830.short_description: Experience all the Onion Kingdom has to offer, Overcooked! 1 & 2 infused with 4k goodness running at a smooth 60 FPS. Fully remastered and cooked up from scratch. Enjoy 200+ levels (22 new) and 80+ chefs (3 new), this is the ultimate Overcooked! experience.

1260320.name: Party Animals
1260320.short_description: Fight your friends as puppies, kittens and other fuzzy creatures in PARTY ANIMALS! Paw it out with your friends remotely, or huddle together for chaotic fun on the same screen. Interact with the world under our realistic physics engine. Did I mention PUPPIES?

1270580.name: Mind Over Magic
1270580.short_description: Mind Over Magic is a colony sim set at the site of a cursed magic school. Build and optimize your own magical academy, train powerful Mages, and master mighty relics in order to battle through the Underschool, a mysterious underground dungeon that holds the key to liberation from a deadly curse.

1286220.name: Sea Power : Naval Combat in the Missile Age
1286220.short_description: From the lead designer of Cold Waters, Sea Power lets you control NATO and Warsaw Pact forces in modern naval conflict campaigns. Use your advanced naval weaponry and sensors to respect rules of engagement and defeat the enemy forces in a tense fight for initiative and air/naval supremacy.

1313140.name: Cult of the Lamb
1313140.short_description: Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland Followers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

1332010.name: Stray
1332010.short_description: Lost, alone and separated from family, a stray cat must untangle an ancient mystery to escape a long-forgotten cybercity and find their way home.

1476970.name: IdleOn - The Incremental MMO
1476970.short_description: The incremental idle MMO where your heroes keep fighting while you're gone! Spend their loot on upgrades, unlock classes from Elemental-Wizard to Cannon-Pirate, and level 20 unique skills like Farming, Sailing, and Construction!

1478970.name: AI Olympius
1478970.short_description: Join the rebels in a third-person shooter with RPG elements and base-building mode. Fight against various combat drone models under the control of the supreme AI.

1562430.name: DREDGE
1562430.short_description: DREDGE is a single-player fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and dredge the depths for long-buried secrets. Explore a mysterious archipelago and discover why some things are best left forgotten.

1564060.name: Lighthouse of Madness
1564060.short_description: Embark on this Lovecraft-inspired tale and discover the mysteries that await you on this island. Explore the island, solve challenging puzzles, and most importantly: try not to lose your sanity.

1566200.name: Tape to Tape
1566200.short_description: Tape to Tape is a roguelite hockey game where every choice matters on your journey to build the best hockey team. Choose your path, hire unique players, discover synergies between them, pick unique abilities, bribe the referees or visit the Blademaster on your way to restore hockey's former glory.

1569580.name: Blue Prince
1569580.short_description: Welcome to Mt. Holly, where every dawn unveils a new mystery. Navigate through shifting corridors and ever-changing chambers in this genre-defying strategy puzzle adventure. But will your unpredictable path lead you to the rumored Room 46?

1594320.name: Captain of Industry
1594320.short_description: Build an industrial empire on a remote island. Mine resources, reshape terrain with excavators, grow food, construct factories, lay train tracks, and trade with the outside world. Research 100+ technologies to advance from basic metal smelting all the way to nuclear power and space flight.

1621690.name: Core Keeper
1621690.short_description: Explore a vast cavern of creatures, relics and resources in a mining sandbox adventure for 1-8 players. Mine, build, fight, craft and farm to unravel the mystery of the ancient Core.

1623730.name: Palworld
1623730.short_description: Fight, farm, build and work alongside mysterious creatures called "Pals" in this completely new multiplayer, open world survival and crafting game!

1713730.name: Moadra
1713730.short_description: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

1721470.name: Poppy Playtime
1721470.short_description: You must stay alive in this horror/puzzle adventure. Try to survive the vengeful toys waiting for you in the abandoned toy factory. Use your GrabPack to hack electrical circuits or nab anything from afar. Explore the mysterious facility... and don't get caught.

1757300.name: Jump Space
1757300.short_description: Jump Space (formerly Jump Ship) is a mission based co-op PvE for 1-4 players, where you are the crew of a spaceship. Transition seamlessly from crewing the ship to on-foot exploration and space walks. Explore, upgrade, and survive intense encounters in deep space together.

1782460.name: Hell Clock
1782460.short_description: Forge powerful builds with endless loot in this relentless combination of Roguelike and ARPG. Blast through dungeons and unleash inhuman powers in a dark fantasy twist on Brazil’s War of Canudos.

1794680.name: Vampire Survivors
1794680.short_description: Mow down thousands of night creatures and survive until dawn! Vampire Survivors is a gothic horror casual game with rogue-lite elements, where your choices can allow you to quickly snowball against the hundreds of monsters that get thrown at you. Be the bullet hell!

1805110.name: Solarpunk™
1805110.short_description: Solarpunk is a survival game in a technologically advanced world of floating islands. Alone or together with your friends, you can construct buildings, grow food, craft gadgets and hop on your airship to explore distant islands in the sky.

1868140.name: DAVE THE DIVER
1868140.short_description: DAVE THE DIVER is a casual, singleplayer adventure RPG featuring deep-sea exploration and fishing during the day and sushi restaurant management at night. Join Dave and his quirky friends as they seek to uncover the secrets of the mysterious Blue Hole.

1876590.name: I Am Your Beast
1876590.short_description: Hunt the military-industrial complex across stylish comic book micro-sandboxes in this fast-paced covert revenge thriller FPS from the developers of El Paso, Elsewhere.

1903340.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
1903340.short_description: Lead the members of Expedition 33 on their quest to destroy the Paintress so that she can never paint death again. Explore a world of wonders inspired by Belle Époque France and battle unique enemies in this turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics.

1913120.name: Tears of Metal
1913120.short_description: Fight solo or up to 4-player co-op to reclaim your island alongside your Scottish battalion. On each campaign, gain new powerful upgrades, rally your forces, and stop the invader as they carve into the Mother Stone to harvest its power.

1931770.name: Chants of Sennaar
1931770.short_description: In this award-winning puzzle adventure game, play as the Traveler on a quest to reunite the Peoples of the Tower. Observe, listen, and decipher ancient languages in a fascinating universe inspired by the Myth of Babel.

1943950.name: Escape the Backrooms
1943950.short_description: Escape the Backrooms is a 1-4 player co-op horror exploration game. Traverse 30+ eerie backrooms levels while avoiding entities and other dangers. Try to escape but be warned: survival isn't guaranteed.

2005010.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun
2005010.short_description: Load up your Boltgun and unleash the awesome Space Marine arsenal to blast your way through an explosion of sprites, pixels and blood in a perfect blend of Warhammer 40,000, frenetic gameplay and the stylish visuals of 90’s retro shooters.

2008920.name: Lorelei and the Laser Eyes
2008920.short_description: The stage is set. Imagine an old baroque manor, perhaps a hotel or a museum, somewhere in central Europe. A woman wanders in search of answers.

2008980.name: XENOTILT: HOSTILE PINBALL ACTION
2008980.short_description: LIGHTNING STRIKES AGAIN!! XENOTILT, the sequel to the cult hit, DEMON'S TILT. Get ready for another PINBALL FANTASY. XENOTILT shreds the envelope with face-melting gameplay & graphics.

2071280.name: Ravenswatch
2071280.short_description: Fallen heroes of old folk tales and legends: you are on the verge of a crucial battle against the Nightmare invading and corrupting your world. A roguelike action game from the creators of Curse of the Dead Gods©, playable solo or in online co-op.

2162800.name: shapez 2 - Factory
2162800.short_description: Dive into a factory-building game with the focus on just that – building huge space factories! Design sprawling multi-level factories and satisfying production lines without limits. Tackle progressively challenging automation goals at your own pace, without the threat of enemies.

2163330.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors
2163330.short_description: The Horde is coming, but you're ready to fight it! Assemble your squad, choose their upgrades, and build powerful synergies against thousands of undead. Survive. Then evolve. Then break every limit in this deceptively simple but addictive bullet heaven game.

2198150.name: Tiny Glade
2198150.short_description: Tiny Glade is a small diorama builder where you doodle whimsical castles, cozy cottages & romantic ruins. Explore gridless building chemistry as the game adorns your glades with procedural detail. No management, combat or goals: just kick back and turn forgotten meadows into lovable dioramas.

2201320.name: Date Everything!
2201320.short_description: Date Everything! is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

2295060.name: Beyond These Stars
2295060.short_description: Build a city on the back of a Space Whale and learn to coexist as you journey through the stars. Manage intricate supply chains and the needs of your people as you build outposts, meet aliens, and uncover the mysteries of the universe.

2379780.name: Balatro
2379780.short_description: The poker roguelike. Balatro is a hypnotically satisfying deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping, outrageous combos.

2407270.name: AI LIMIT
2407270.short_description: In the distant future when civilization is on the verge of extinction, people follow the legend of the Elysium in the last city, Havenswell. In this post-apocalyptic wasteland sci-fi ARPG, you will play as Arrisa, a Blader with immortality, and explore the city ruin to find the hope of a new life.

2420580.name: ALYSSA
2420580.short_description: From the creator of Don't Be Afraid. You are a little girl trapped inside a nightmarish mansion, where twisted residents, dark secrets, and a conspiracy far greater than it first appears await behind every closed door.

2428110.name: Who Invited You?
2428110.short_description: Some of your party guests were never invited. They look like your friends, answer to their names, and behave exactly the same. Photos, messages and phone calls are the only proof. Find them before the night ends — alone or with up to three friends.

2436940.name: Sephiria
2436940.short_description: Save Bunnyville from a doomed fate: a top-down action/RPG roguelite from the makers of Dungreed. Explore the depths of the tower, collect and upgrade artifacts, and defeat hordes of demons to keep your village safe.

2451700.name: Atrion Project
2451700.short_description: A hybrid with no memories. A planet out to kill you. A demanding sci-fi action game with fast-paced combat and die & retry mechanics. Fight. Die. Learn. Retry. Your body is a weapon. Your past, a mystery.

2475490.name: Mouthwashing
2475490.short_description: The five crew members of the Tulpar are stranded in the empty reaches of space, shrouded in perpetual sunset. God is not watching.

2488560.name: Abandoned Hearts
2488560.short_description: Abandoned Hearts is a single-player detective horror game. Investigate a fatal castle fire, connect clues on an evidence board, and draw your own conclusions. Run, hide, and distract what stalks the halls. The families need answers. You need to make it out alive.

2592160.name: Dispatch
2592160.short_description: Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero. All episodes out now!

2643390.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown
2643390.short_description: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown is a story-driven survival strategy game in which the fate of the iconic starship is in your hands. Take the helm, manage the ship and resources, and make difficult decisions. Will you be able to bring home the ship and its crew?

2670630.name: Supermarket Simulator
2670630.short_description: Run your own supermarket! Stock shelves, set your prices, take payments, hire staff, expand your store, handle shoplifters, and design your layout. Purchase goods from online or local markets around town, and personally deliver online orders to your customers.

2764460.name: Sandustry
2764460.short_description: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.

2835570.name: Buckshot Roulette
2835570.short_description: Play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge shotgun. Four enter. One leaves. Roll the dice with your life. Good luck!

2868840.name: Slay the Spire 2
2868840.short_description: The iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power in Slay the Spire 2!

2929250.name: over the hill
2929250.short_description: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

2950790.name: IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator
2950790.short_description: IRON NEST is a brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery game where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Take map measurements based on the received coordinates, strain the hydraulics, and gunlay the cannons to unleash devastating blows ⟹ Will you obey High Command, Operator?

2967950.name: The Witch's Bakery
2967950.short_description: The Witch's Bakery is a 2D narrative Adventure RPG where you live a magical life as a witch-baker in Paris! Serve customers, visit iconic streets and heal people's heart with your croissants 🥐

3065940.name: Gallipoli
3065940.short_description: Land on the beaches of Gallipoli and fight intense 50-player objective-based battles on the Ottoman Fronts! Experience WW1 trench warfare and desert expeditions as one of 10 historic classes, armed with authentic weaponry. Gallipoli brings the most immersive WW1 FPS battles yet.

3070070.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
3070070.short_description: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

3097560.name: Liar's Bar
3097560.short_description: Dive into this multiplayer online experience set in a sketchy bar where the games are as dangerous as the patrons. Join a table of 4 and test your skills in Liar's Dice and Liar's Deck, where lying and bluffing are key to victory. Ready for a night at Liar's Bar?

3115160.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
3115160.short_description: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with MORE enemies, MORE weapons, and NEW ways to purge!

3164500.name: Schedule I
3164500.short_description: From small-time dope pusher to kingpin - manufacture and distribute a range of drugs throughout the grungy city of Hyland Point. Expand your empire with properties, businesses, employees and more.

3167020.name: Escape From Duckov
3167020.short_description: Escape from Duckov is a PVE indie survival RPG — in a duck's world!. Scavenge for resources, build your hideout, and upgrade your gear in the world of Duckov. Start from nothing and rise to the top. Outwit hostile ducks, survive, or make it out alive.

3180070.name: No, I'm not a Human
3180070.short_description: WARNING. Stay inside. Lock your doors. Close the blinds. Only let humans in. Eliminate all Visitors. An anxiety horror about paranoia in the End of Times.

3247750.name: Mycopunk
3247750.short_description: Cut through fungal aliens in this hyper-customizable, mission based looter shooter. Hundreds of hand-crafted upgrades, 4-player co-op, and a little roach man. What’s not to love?

3265700.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
3265700.short_description: From the creators of Vampire Survivors comes a turbo-charged, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder! Deal world-ending combos, blitz through infested dungeons, and master the Turboturn to obliterate hordes of familiar foes with a chaotic hand of cards.

3271280.name: Shroom and Gloom
3271280.short_description: Gather and grow cards in Shroom & Gloom, a moody first-person, roguelike double-deckbuilder bursting with fungal foes and mountains of mega-combos!

3280980.name: Mimic Alert
3280980.short_description: You are on a service to detect and destroy mimics — creatures capable of taking the form of any object. Carefully inspect your surroundings and use all your attentiveness to detect them. Play the full campaign in online two-player co-op with a friend.

3483740.name: Cast n Chill
3483740.short_description: Cast n Chill is a relaxing fishing game where you explore serene lakes, rivers, and oceans. Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear and reel in legendary catches - all with your loyal companion by your side.

3552140.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
3552140.short_description: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

3582250.name: Farm to Table
3582250.short_description: A farming & restaurant management sim with base building elements. Grow in backyard to cook & serve! Discover new recipes by exploring ingredients on the island; gather, fish, raise animals & produce with machines. Manage resources, hire staff & grow your organic business into a 5-star restaurant!

3596870.name: Sakura Hime 7
3596870.short_description: In a paradise of blooming cherry blossoms, catgirls, witches, and elves gather around you. Share sweet everyday moments with them and build a lavish harem all your own.

3614130.name: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop
3614130.short_description: Restore order to three ransacked fantasy shops! Organize thousands of items, master helpful sorceries and enchantments, relax at your own pace, race the global leaderboards, and unlock new ways to play. Every item has a shelf. Can you find them all?

3645890.name: GONE Fishing
3645890.short_description: GONE Fishing is a 1-8 player survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?

3669570.name: Alchemy Factory
3669570.short_description: Start small, team up with friends, and automate production with conveyor belts, pipes, and magical devices. Stock your shop with potions, jewelry, and relics, complete commissions, and build an alchemy empire! Alchemy Factory 1.0 is out now with the Wagon Logistics System and revamped shopkeeping.

3690870.name: Tow Game
3690870.short_description: Tow Game is a physics-based action game where you control a car being towed by a tow truck. Swing around the environment using the tow cable and earn points by causing chaos and destruction.

3699590.name: Well Dweller
3699590.short_description: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

3812600.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
3812600.short_description: Run a quaint electronics repair shop in mid-2000s Tokyo. Grow your business by carefully restoring iconic video game consoles, cell phones, music players, and other nostalgic devices. Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.

3827330.name: Midnight Launch: A Gameshop Sim
3827330.short_description: Run a GameShop set in the early 2000's. Manage your products for sale such as games, consoles, and accessories. Customize your store and your character to make it your own. Play solo or enjoy up to a 4 player co-op and run the store your way.

3844890.name: Lost Jelly
3844890.short_description: An arcade adventure with a new twist!🚀 The alien robot Nimble must gather all the runaway Jelly after a crash landing. But there's a catch — his brakes are broken! Every move must be carefully planned, because once Nimble starts going, he won’t stop.

3883570.name: Invokyr
3883570.short_description: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play in a group of 6 players. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.

3907910.name: Cutout Village
3907910.short_description: Build your own little paper village in this relaxing city-builder focused on building and crafting. Cut, fold and glue to help it grow, discover its story and join its inhabitants as they slowly bring life back to its streets.

3911820.name: 100 Cats Lost in Canada 2 Find & Color
3911820.short_description: 🐱 Discover 200 hidden cats across 2 artistic hand-drawn scenes 🖌️. Relax with color-by-numbers 🎨 and add life to every detail. Play solo or in cozy co-op 👯‍♂️, while Meow FM 🎶 sets the perfect creative mood.

3917700.name: Dicevaders
3917700.short_description: Dicevaders is a dice-based roguelike deckbuilder about leading the ultimate alien invasion. Set in the StarVaders universe, draft and manipulate the dice row, build an unstoppable army, and unleash adrenaline pumping combos through powerful synergies and strategic play.

3948120.name: Scritchy Scratchy
3948120.short_description: Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots. Will you play it safe or go all-in?

3949040.name: RV There Yet?
3949040.short_description: A co-op adventure about driving your Recreational Vehicle home.

3996640.name: Inky's Sleep
3996640.short_description: Step into Inky’s sleep — a haunting yet enchanting 2D horror-adventure with surreal touches, led by an endearing little cat. Explore dark dreams, unravel uncanny puzzles, and evade otherworldly creatures.

4001890.name: How to Fish
4001890.short_description: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

4006760.name: Desktop Taxi
4006760.short_description: A cozy idle taxi sim with Lofi beats. Grow your taxi business quietly in the corner of your screen while you work.

4019220.name: Dressmaker
4019220.short_description: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.

4045750.name: Out of the Park Baseball 27
4045750.short_description: 27 years of sports gaming excellence! Out of the Park Baseball 27 is here - officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc. and KBO! You are firmly in charge of your favorite baseball franchise - today or at any point in history! Your team, your way, your rules.

4075620.name: Combolands: Roguelike Citybuilder
4075620.short_description: A mini citybuilding roguelike. Place buildings, stack combos, and master deep strategy in short bursts to create a tiny thriving metropolis!

4087210.name: Red Rain
4087210.short_description: Survive a decimated yet beautiful post-apocalyptic landscape as Allie, a competent survivalist and mother raising her daughter against the backdrop of a broken world.

4108000.name: Machine Party
4108000.short_description: Machine Party is a collection of violent party games where failure is lethal. Gather your friends and endure high stakes situations to prove your life is worth more than theirs. Survival is unlikely.

4113940.name: Sovereign Tower
4113940.short_description: Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

4121170.name: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek
4121170.short_description: After noticing bone-chilling similarities to an episode of Fears to Fathom, Tessa and Marcus decide to share their own experience. Scratch Creek is an exclusively online co-op experience.

4160210.name: The Artisan of Glimmith
4160210.short_description: The Artisan of Glimmith is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about coloring stained glass and restoring the artworks of a kingdom above the clouds. Explore a world of handcrafted puzzles designed with intent, where simple rules lead to delightful surprises.

4197610.name: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!
4197610.short_description: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library! is a single-player simulation. You need return scattered books to proper places in an Arcane Library. As completed rows of bookshelves, you can learn ability to improve your efficiency. Use your skills and strategies to shelve 3,072 books as quick as you can.

4199960.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
4199960.short_description: Escape the ordinary with The Jackbox Party Pack 12! Embark on a party adventure with goofy greetings in We Forgot a Card, wild image warping in Hyperface, absurd arguments in Debate and Switch, team-based fact battles in Idol Factions, and mind-melding friendship in MegaPals.

4207990.name: GemCraft - Legacy Collection
4207990.short_description: Forge and combine magical gems, build deadly defenses, and survive relentless waves in the Flash-era tower defense classics GemCraft, Chapter Zero, and Labyrinth. Now with up to 9x speed, new hotkeys, easier gem combining, and smoother performance.

4247410.name: Run, Run from the Blast!
4247410.short_description: Challenge yourself in a frantic escape through an urban environment, where every mistake brings you one step closer to your demise. Only a perfect run will truly give you a chance to make it out alive.

4285690.name: Airport Security Sucks!
4285690.short_description: Embody your inner power-tripping TSA agent and hunt down other players attempting to blend in and smuggle contraband past you. Control the crowd and your problematic K9 with authoritative voice commands, and use "compliance devices" to apprehend smugglers making mischief or hiding in plain sight.

4303660.name: Wartide
4303660.short_description: A military idle defense that runs as a desktop widget or full screen. Deploy infantry, tanks and gunships against waves from every side, evolve eight vehicle lines from WWII to modern armor and call in air strikes. Pin it beside your work, or go full screen and take command.

4304900.name: Big Dig
4304900.short_description: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway across the Animal Republic!

4314340.name: The Reflection
4314340.short_description: The Reflection is a ritual-based co-op horror game focused on tension, teamwork, and survival. Trapped inside a cursed mansion, players must a investigate supernatural event, perform the correct rituals, and exorcise a dangerous entity before it consumes them.

4338180.name: Dearbnb
4338180.short_description: Buy, Decorate, Rent, Relax. Start with a tiny apartment, decorate cozy spaces, manage rentals and businesses, and rise from a poor neighborhood to the city’s most prestigious zones. A calming yet deep management experience where every room tells a story.

4364930.name: Birb
4364930.short_description: Start as a humble birb, eat popcorn, and evolve into a cosmic force of nature! Birb blends addictive idle mechanics with active roguelite expeditions. Build your nest, catch rare fish, challenge bosses, and compete on the global leaderboard. How many pecks will it take to rule the world?

4409620.name: ARCS
4409620.short_description: A stage‑based shooter where you build optimal strategies and wipe out over a thousand enemies.

4413070.name: Red Chat Ritual  – TSUMIMI TIME
4413070.short_description: “Intervene in Tsumimi’s stream” through comments and Mega Chats, then use your deductions to change their fate in this 15-day psychological horror adventure.

4421010.name: Bills Must Be Paid
4421010.short_description: You're broke, smash piggy banks, bills must be paid. A short active incremental game. Get money, upgrade, and get debt free!

4425980.name: Legion Breaker
4425980.short_description: Legion Breaker is an active incremental game about growing a novice wizard into an unstoppable battlemage. Unlock powerful spells, raise a holy army, and crush undead hordes across expanding battlefields on your way to the Necromancer King.

4509200.name: Grease Trap '99
4509200.short_description: Mystery Horror / Comedic Takeaway Simulator. Deep-fry pizzas and live the Scottish dream. Voice-acted in Scottish Gaelic; subtitles in English or Gaelic.

4541170.name: Retro Pond
4541170.short_description: Breed unique fish, discover rare mutations and grow your pond.

4560000.name: Battle Nap
4560000.short_description: Battle Nap is a roguelite top-down shooter where your picnic nap becomes an explosive journey into dreamland domination. Build your arsenal, stack your perks, and blast through your subconscious to ensure you don’t wake up until the job is done. Don't wake up - the fight is just getting good!

4621970.name: Loop Dungeon - Incremental
4621970.short_description: A short incremental dungeon RPG with a finite campaign. Unlock heroes, gather resources, upgrade your party, and reset progress for prestige rewards. Heroes fight automatically, but skills and upgrades need your input—not a fully hands-off idle game.

4627110.name: Fell & Sell
4627110.short_description: Slay. Loot. Sell. Survive! Dive into a first-person blend of hack'n'slash roguelike and shop management. Plunder deadly dungeons for loot, escape with your life, craft, and stock your shelves. Then risk it all once more for profit!

4629050.name: Eric's Farm
4629050.short_description: Feed 'em... or get BONKED! Toss ridiculous snacks, dodge hangry animals and smash through ten chaotic days in a slapstick 3D farm game. Take on bosses, five minigames and Endless Mode, then unlock The Back Forty: grow crops, drive tractors and build your own farm.

4642780.name: SAKIMORI
4642780.short_description: Explore cursed locations, locate cursed objects, and purify them. Alongside the guardian Saku Tsukino, confront the curse within an anomalous space, purify the cursed objects, and survive. A first-person horror Roguelite set in abandoned Japanese locations.

4656000.name: BOMBANANA!
4656000.short_description: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?

4659620.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
4659620.short_description: Dodge the barrage, defeat the enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist Incident. The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics. Control the shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa, weaving between bullets that fill up the screen. The soundtrack has been fully remade by ZUN.

4704690.name: MECCHA CHAMELEON
4704690.short_description: Paint yourself to blend in! "Meccha Chameleon" is a new-sensation hide-and-seek game where you paint your white body to mimic the stage. Spot, pose, and "artistic skill" are keys to survival. Deceive Seekers with techniques that put chameleons to shame! Supports public matches and streaming.

4705510.name: Happy Wheels
4705510.short_description: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.

4731510.name: Subject Zero
4731510.short_description: You are a scientist turned into test subject zero, forced to fight the infection by venturing through your own nightmares. Will you survive.

4756450.name: Evercursed: Act I
4756450.short_description: Evercursed is a narrative-driven, atmospheric horror experience that delves into the world of sleep paralysis, and the demons that lurk within it. Step into Amelia's haunting nightmares, where the line between dreams and reality is blurred.

4859550.name: BioSphere: Genesis
4859550.short_description: A science clicker inspired by real biochemistry. Grow a living planet from elementary particles: catch atoms, fuse them into molecules, synthesize amino acids, proteins and cells — turn raw matter into life through simple clicks. No prestige points, only natural units.

4968640.name: Japanese Ramen Simulator
4968640.short_description: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a ramen shop management sim for up to six players. Prepare ingredients, cook noodles, and arrange toppings to craft the perfect bowl. Create original dishes, design your kitchen and dining area, and build your ramen restaurant with friends or on your own!

4977840.name: Otherside Tapes: Favela
4977840.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game with a found-footage aesthetic. In search of the mysterious Street 7, an urban explorer finds himself trapped in a loop of distorted realities, rituals, and a supernatural presence that controls the Favela das Almas.

5013160.name: Hubble Bubble
5013160.short_description: Co-op hookah shop sim for 1 to 4 friends. Run Ghalyan's Hookah Lounge on a space station: pack the bowl, light the coals, serve the aliens and act normal. Nothing on this station is normal.

5064340.name: DinoBones: Tidy Up the Museum
5064340.short_description: DinoBones: Tidy Up the Museum! is a cozy skeleton restoration sim. Identify, collect, and piece together around 2,000 scattered dinosaur bones. Feel chaos turn into order, and with every skeleton you rebuild, the museum reveals another secret.

5081300.name: MECCHA LIAR
5081300.short_description: 2 to 4 participants gathered in pursuit of a massive cash prize. The moment they open their eyes, they are trapped in unfamiliar darkness and each other's lies. In a place where no one can be trusted, only one can survive.

5100710.name: Orbital Madness
5100710.short_description: Orbital Madness is an incremental action roguelite where everything revolves around orbitals. Build an arsenal of spinning weapons, create ridiculous chaos, defeat hordes of enemies and grow stronger between every run.

5101180.name: The World's Shortest Horror Game
5101180.short_description: Press one button. Regret it immediately. A bite-sized analog horror comedy made to be finished in minutes, streamed for reactions, or gifted to a friend as a tiny act of betrayal. Headphones strongly recommended. Friendship not guaranteed.

5101820.name: CUSTOM PENNANT BASEBALL
5101820.short_description: Draft prospects, develop your players and build a championship club. Set lineups, negotiate contracts and manage your budget in this baseball management sim. Discover hidden prospects, invest in your town and customize your league. Watch games without direct player control.

5104990.name: NARNOK: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug In My Power Cables
5104990.short_description: im a brain in a jar now and I got these cables that gotta be plugged in but there are many dangerous things in the way, so its always a PUZZLE to solve haha

5127370.name: Who's Cheating?
5127370.short_description: Everyone is gambling. One player is cheating. In this social deduction game for 3 to 8 players, the Cheater uses glasses that reveal the next winning bet while the Security Guard studies the tables, reads the bets and decides who gets the shotgun. Lie, steal and larp over proximity chat.

5132600.name: Touwers: Defend the Realm
5132600.short_description: Touwers is a fantasy tower defense strategy game where you place towers on a grid, hold the line through escalating enemy waves, and grow your economy to be able to unlock all kinds of perks along your way through 4 distinct campaigns.

5132990.name: Puppet Mall: Chapter 1: Lost Friend
5132990.short_description: Explore the abandoned Puppet Mall, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of its dark past. As John, confront the mall's mysteries and discover what really happened there while investigating the story of Mike and Chris. But be careful... You are not alone.

5134280.name: The Guest from the Fields
5134280.short_description: Something is standing in the wheat. Each time you see it, it's closer — and it isn't human. Your grandmother says you shouldn't have looked at it.

5140670.name: The Grave Abyss
5140670.short_description: Grab your sword and descend to the deepest depths of a corrupted cave to find and destroy the source of evil that plagues the small town of Oakhaven. The Grave Abyss is an old school single player, 3d dungeon crawler RPG with turn based combat.

5144200.name: Hurl
5144200.short_description: HURL is a multiplayer platform game where you battle your friends in a gutty arena. The winner transforms into a massive worm, and eats away the terrain to create the next map.

5176820.name: DEAD TIME
5176820.short_description: Nobody can see the timers. 2–8 players strapped to their chairs at a sinister game-show table, shock collars on: estimate time blind, bluff, call people out. Miss the time and the collar answers; get doubted and the doubter pulls the trigger. Local, online or solo vs. bots.

5204830.name: Deleted Wiki: Clean Up the Lost Files

5207010.name: Gateholt
5207010.short_description: Gateholt is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Enter a cursed place and erase the marks an evil spirit has left behind. Every mark you erase brings it closer. You cannot fight it — run, or hide. The way back is still open.

5208860.name: Dub House
5208860.short_description: One to eight players, a party game where you only use your voice, Take a character each, record your lines, then watch it back with your takes where the actors used to be. Four modes: Dub, Telephone, Rap Booth. Plus a clip editor

5215390.name: UNCOUNTED
5215390.short_description: Uncounted is a massive incremental tower defense. One sector, one wave: tens of thousands of hostiles simulated on the GPU. Place and aim every turret before the drop, then spend the run to unlock the next gun.

5222980.name: Renz Soccer Sim
5222980.short_description: Build your squad, develop players, manage your club, and watch every match unfold in this 2D soccer management simulator. Chase trophies and build a dynasty.

5227910.name: Messa Anomaly
5227910.short_description: Messa Anomaly is a first-person psychological horror game set in an endlessly shifting museum. Observe each corridor, spot unsettling changes, and choose the correct path. One mistake can send you deeper into a night shift that refuses to end.

5228920.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
5228920.short_description: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!

5231450.name: THERMAL RUNAWAY
5231450.short_description: A top-down roguelite inside one sealed chamber. Ten levels, one hundred waves, and upgrades that compound into something the facility was not built to contain. The run ends when you break — or when the reaction does.

5236110.name: Teleport Master
5236110.short_description: Teleport Master is a first-person puzzle adventure where you create portals to move through space, reach impossible places, and solve clever environmental challenges. Explore stylized sci-fi levels, experiment with movement, and find your way forward.

5258340.name: One Million Coins
5258340.short_description: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.

5260110.name: Second Source
5260110.short_description: Every report on your desk is intelligence or bait. Four artifacts — agency, timestamp, position, text — and a planted one contradicts itself in exactly one. Call it before the clock does, hold the line as DEFCON drops, and when they breach the building, run the extraction on foot.

5269280.name: The 31st Student
5269280.short_description: Thirty names. Thirty-one desks. Explore a deserted Japanese high school, uncover conflicting records, and confront the memories you helped erase. A first-person psychological horror mystery with three endings. Play on a monitor or in VR.

5273460.name: Rouge and Run
5273460.short_description: Dive into the cursed world of Rouge and Run. Customize your loadout, strategies, and plan your time management wisely to escape The Fog of Rouge from consuming you.

5278050.name: Fish Wrangler
5278050.short_description: The idle fishing RPG that has been running since 2008. Cast your line, walk away, and let your crew keep fishing while life happens. Catch and collect 2,200+ species across 111 towns, level up ridiculous poles, and find out what Cousin Earl keeps in the bait shed.

5279620.name: Halloween On Goober Street
5279620.short_description: Halloween On Goober Street is a first-person horror-comedy taking place on Halloween night. Players must Trick-or-Treat their way to 100 candies or face the consequences. With lots of fun interactions and scares with the zippiest of characters, this Halloween night is one sure to be remembered.

5283650.name: Postpartum | 산후조리원
5283650.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set over five days in a Korean postpartum care center. The nurse was replaced overnight, and the new one always seems to be holding your baby.

5287260.name: Pactmage - Chess Roster
5287260.short_description: Pactmage: Chess Roster is a turn-based tactics game where every character has skills and an element. Win in Adventure Mode and form a Pact to recruit them — all 60+ units are free. Play the story mode, fight a friend locally, or battle online in PvP. No gacha, no paid units.

5291460.name: Empty The Lake!
5291460.short_description: Empty the lake, make money, and discover what’s hidden at the bottom! Pump out thousands of liters of water, upgrade your tools, and keep going deeper to uncover what lies beneath the surface.

5292500.name: ゆめみるサクラの卒業式
5292500.short_description: A graduation that breaks, again and again. It should have been an ordinary day where all you had to do was choose which friend to talk to first. The order changes the conversations, and each loop warps the scene. Your friends' smiles fade. A visual novel about friendship. Broken, with care.

5295940.name: /deploy.self
5295940.short_description: You're being sent down, one way only. A lonely descent through the shaft in a small elevator, through the ice of Europa, Jupiter's moon, and your only connection to the world is an old console.

5297320.name: JIGOKU YUGI: Only The Last Gambler Standing Returns to Life
5297320.short_description: You died slipping on your own winning lottery ticket. Now you're one of 100 corpses in Hell's Ninth Gambling Den: 32 sadistic games, each with a hidden trap, a cheating demon croupier and your funeral streaming live. Only the last gambler standing returns to life.

5301680.name: Flamebound Tactics
5301680.short_description: Flamebound Tactics is a pixel-art strategy puzzle. Place units on suitable terrain, combine their unique coverage patterns, and light every brazier without exceeding the budget. Solve 30 handcrafted stages across islands of varied shapes and terrain.

5303370.name: Suspencil
5303370.short_description: An online drawing and social deduction game for up to 8 players. Draw your prompt and discuss the drawings to find the Werewolf—the only one with a different prompt. The Madman scribbles on others’ drawings to help the Werewolf. Even if caught, the Werewolf can win by guessing the Citizens’ prompt.

5305740.name: Uncanny Train
5305740.short_description: A horror puzzle walking simulator. Trapped aboard a strange train, your goal is to reach Carriage -1. Along the way, you will encounter eerie anomalies and solve environmental puzzles. Headphones are recommended for full immersion.

5306880.name: Gross Survivors
5306880.short_description: Play as the grossest survivors in town in this fast-paced top-down roguelite! Armed with raw fart power and other foul abilities, blast through endless enemy swarms across 2 arenas. Collect coins, upgrade your powers, and turn your nastiest traits into ultimate weapons!

5313320.name: Zombie Last Stand
5313320.short_description: Take your last stand against an evolving zombie swarm. Fight ten enemy types and two deadly bosses, collect special bullets, armor and permanent upgrades, survive extreme weather events, unlock SWAT skins, complete achievements, and chase a higher score with every run.

5327800.name: Last Light: Chalk Creek
5327800.short_description: Three strangers are stranded in a rural town overrun by the infected and things that crawl out of the ground. Fight through an illustrated three-chapter story or hold out for three days in an isometric shooter with nine weapons, destructible scenery, dynamic weather and a day–night cycle.

5328990.name: Trivia Mania
5328990.short_description: Welcome to Trivia Mania! Test your knowledge about the most common trivia questions, and improve your own performance. Trivia Mania has over 4,700 questions across eight genres. Game modes such as the Gauntlet, Ladder, Survival and Custom allow you to play in different fun and interactive ways.

5329480.name: Solo Shift! Karaoke
5329480.short_description: Front desk, food and drinks, cleaning—you've got to manage it all! Take on task after task all by yourself!

5335510.name: Moon Sweepers
5335510.short_description: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.

5339480.name: Terra Machina
5339480.short_description: Dig deep, build big, and let science do the smashing! TerraMachina is a 2D mining and factory sandbox. Turn mountains of ore into powerful drills, weapons, and automated factories across diverse biomes. Play solo or in co-op for up to 4 players.

5341000.name: Ashnar's Lair
5341000.short_description: A traditional roguelike built around your character. Unlock seven classes by your deeds, grow them through three talent trees and hunt gear with rolled affixes. Elite foes and whole dungeons roll affixes too, and every one changes how you fight. One life per run. Will you defeat Ashnar?

5341070.name: The Wrong Way
5341070.short_description: The Wrong Way is a psychological horror experience about a camping trip that takes a dark turn when one friend drives home alone and ends up on a road he was never supposed to be on. Sometimes the most dangerous places are the ones you stumble into by accident.

5346530.name: ZakuzakuTreasure
5346530.short_description: Battles run on their own. Send a party of four into dungeons, scoop up piles of gear, upgrade it, and push deeper. With levels up to 999 and over 100 dungeons, this is an idle hack-and-slash RPG that keeps going while you watch.

5347940.name: PALJA Survivors
5347940.short_description: A survival roguelike where your birth date determines your Saju character. Dodge swarming foes, choose upgrades and items, and face five years of yearly battles and Guardians shaped by your fortune. Even with the same Saju, your choices lead to a different journey.

5352190.name: Six-Leaf Clover Hunt
5352190.short_description: A quiet first-person search in a sunlit forest clearing. Hidden among more than 500,000 life-sized clovers are 54 four-leaf clovers, 18 five-leaf clovers and just one six-leaf clover. Crouch down, part the leaves, pick a clover and count its leaflets with your own eyes. No time limit.

5352440.name: RETURN TO 1990
5352440.short_description: Reborn in 1990 Seoul with memories of 2027. Rewrite twenty years through stocks, real estate and startups in this business-sim visual novel.

5354400.name: Sudoku Unlimited
5354400.short_description: Settle into a cozy garden of Sudoku. Solve classic grids and clever variants, learn with step-by-step hints, and unlock new scenery as you play. Share a board in online co-op or keep a small puzzle beside your other apps.

5358030.name: Lumbrix
5358030.short_description: Lumbrix is a survivors-like shooter where every segment of your growing worm is both a weapon and a life. Aim your head cannon, shield yourself with your body, evolve your weapons and survive ten minutes to face the boss.

5362280.name: Fungal Field
5362280.short_description: Start with a seed. Change more than the landscape. Fungal Field is an ecological sandbox where colonies grow, wildlife forages, and fungal infection can turn deer and humans into zombies. Nurture the soil. Shape the conditions. Discover what grows from here.

5364150.name: Fruitpocalypse
5364150.short_description: The veggies have risen. Only the fruits stand in their way. Survive 20 waves of evil vegetables, twisted bosses and cursed nights in this cartoon arena roguelite.

5364370.name: Dungeon Prisoner Simulator
5364370.short_description: Thrown into a dungeon after delivering your king’s ultimatum, you have one goal: survive 72 real gameplay hours until his army arrives. Drink, sleep, keep the rats away, and wait...

5364850.name: Doomward: Dungeon Autobattler
5364850.short_description: Run a guild of doomed heroes. Hire, specialize, gear and program them, then watch every fight play itself. A roguelike autobattler with permadeath, town sieges and a raid-boss Herald at the end of the Doom Clock. Solo, co-op for up to 4, or PvP.

5365190.name: Tidy Tails
5365190.short_description: Your cat has turned the shop upside down, and 5,555 cat plushies are waiting to go back on their shelves. Upgrade your skills and your cat's, change the weather to transform the gameplay, play minigames and hunt for collectibles while you wonder what the garage hides once everything is tidy.

5365780.name: Deckbound
5365780.short_description: Summoned to a world ruled by the Demon Lord, your only power is your deck. Dodge bullet-hell attacks in real time, fight with a 4-card hand, and loot a permanent card collection from procedural dungeons. Teleport home before you lose it all. Solo or 2-4 player co-op.

5367850.name: Little Spring
5367850.short_description: Compress. Aim. Release. Guide a little spring through the pages of an old patent. Judge slopes, ride moving platforms and set curious mechanisms in motion across 20 handcrafted physics challenges. Unlock six springs, each with a character of its own.

5373530.name: Robot Fisher
5373530.short_description: Third person fishing simulation game, where player controls lonely robot who are just fishing

5377090.name: Dealer's Choice
5377090.short_description: Three roguelites at one table. Drop balls through a plinko board, roll dice for poker hands, bet against a roulette wheel you rebuild as you play — then push your luck for one more floor, one more roll, one more spin. The Dealer is watching.

5377200.name: Chained Pirates Together
5377200.short_description: A cursed skull has chained your crew together, and only a lightning strike at the summit can break it. Climb 1000 meters in this physics-based co-op climbing game for 1–4 pirates, where one bad jump drags everyone down with you.

5381850.name: Elevator Button Simulator
5381850.short_description: Step into an elevator, press the buttons, and travel between floors. A simulator built around a small part of everyday life. Enjoy watching the elevator respond to each press.

5382570.name: Rêverie: Audio Stories
5382570.short_description: Close your eyes, listen, and choose. Rêverie brings you illustrated audio stories where your choices change the ending. Two free stories: a king's messenger on a stormy medieval night, and a fairy tale full of songs for young and old. No ads.

5383020.name: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia
5383020.short_description: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia is a third-person fighting game centered on the mafia, in which you must build up your own gang and defeat all your enemies.

5383030.name: Police Activity: Cardboardman
5383030.short_description: Police Activity: Cardboardman is a first-person slasher game where, in one segment, you play as a serial killer nicknamed "Cardboardman," and in the other, as a detective trying to catch him.

5386200.name: Mojo Is Loved
5386200.short_description: Mojo invites his ex and an old friend to hear his new EP. Their kindness is real... until the room starts rewriting every sign of rejection. A short psychological horror visual novel about love, reassurance, and the cost of demanding certainty.

5389350.name: Starfall Hill
5389350.short_description: Stars really fall from the sky over a quiet hilltop village. Gather them, light the lamps, and meet the villagers—until a black warship crosses the moon. Take up an old rifle and exploding stars to defend the hill in this story-driven first-person adventure.

5403390.name: Super Clown Save Santa
5403390.short_description: 2.5d Platformer where you control Super Clown. Mission to avoid traps and enemies and enemy bee and Save Santa Claus and Save Christmas

5404530.name: PLEASE WAIT
5404530.short_description: A comedy game about installing a game. Get the progress bar from 0% to 100% while the installer stalls, bargains, lies, makes you agree to agree, runs away from your cursor and refuses to finish. One window. One loading bar. Please wait.

5406050.name: Bunny Bun
5406050.short_description: You are the experimenter Bunny Bun. To develop the “Wisdom Potion,” you have brought your talents to this laboratory. You must process raw materials and synthesize them to create potions with specific effects. To test a potion, you can take a sip and go crazy. The world needs you...

5409020.name: Spin To Win
5409020.short_description: Flick, brake and reverse your way from one tiny fidget spinner to a bustling pixel arcade. Restore machines, build gadget combinations, master mouse driven minigames and spend earned Tickets on chance games and cosmetics.

3590.name: Plants vs. Zombies GOTY Edition
3590.short_description: Zombies are invading your home, and the only defense is your arsenal of plants! Armed with an alien nursery-worth of zombie-zapping plants like peashooters and cherry bombs, you'll need to think fast and plant faster to stop dozens of types of zombies dead in their tracks.

206440.name: To the Moon
206440.short_description: A story-driven experience about two doctors traversing backwards through a dying man's memories to artificially fulfill his last wish.

303310.name: The House in Fata Morgana
303310.short_description: A gothic suspense tale set in a cursed mansion. "The House in Fata Morgana" is a full-length visual novel spanning nearly a millennium that deals in tragedy, human nature, and insanity.

311690.name: Enter the Gungeon
311690.short_description: Enter the Gungeon is a bullet hell dungeon crawler following a band of misfits seeking to shoot, loot, dodge roll and table-flip their way to personal absolution by reaching the legendary Gungeon’s ultimate treasure: the gun that can kill the past.

410340.name: Liftoff®: FPV Drone Racing
410340.short_description: Liftoff® is a drone simulator that translates the rush of first-person view drone flight to the digital world. Join the biggest community for virtual FPV racing and freestyle!

477160.name: Human Fall Flat
477160.short_description: Human Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted platformer set in floating dreamscapes that can be played solo or with up to 8 players online. Free new levels keep its vibrant community rewarded.

568220.name: Lobotomy Corporation | Monster Management Simulation
568220.short_description: A roguelite monster-management simulation inspired by the likes of the SCP Foundation, Cabin in the Woods, and Warehouse 13. Order your employees to perform work with the creatures and watch as it unfolds; harness greater energy, and expand the facility

625960.name: Stoneshard
625960.short_description: Stoneshard is a hardcore turn-based RPG about the harsh life of a medieval mercenary: travel with your own caravan, descend into procedurally generated dungeons, learn new skills, survive hunger and injuries - and remember, every mistake can mean death and loss of progress.

632470.name: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut
632470.short_description: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut is a groundbreaking role playing game. You’re a detective with a unique skill system at your disposal and a whole city to carve your path across. Interrogate unforgettable characters, crack murders or take bribes. Become a hero or an absolute disaster of a human being.

728880.name: Overcooked! 2
728880.short_description: Overcooked returns with a brand-new helping of chaotic cooking action! Journey back to the Onion Kingdom and assemble your team of chefs in classic couch co-op or online play for up to four players. Hold onto your aprons… it’s time to save the world again!

774361.name: Blasphemous
774361.short_description: Blasphemous is a brutal action-platformer with skilled hack’n slash combat set in the nightmare world of Cvstodia. Explore, upgrade your abilities, and perform savage executions on the hordes of enemies that stand between you and your quest to break eternal damnation.

809230.name: Unity of Command II
809230.short_description: Unity of Command II is the sequel to one of the most critically acclaimed strategy games of all time; a game critics called 'the perfect gateway' into computer war games.

977950.name: A Dance of Fire and Ice
977950.short_description: A Dance of Fire and Ice is a strict rhythm game. Keep your focus as you guide two orbiting planets along a winding path without breaking their perfect equilibrium.

979110.name: Space Haven
979110.short_description: Embark on a space voyage with your ragtag crew of civilians in search of a new home. Build spaceships tile by tile, create optimal gas conditions, manage the needs and moods of their crew, encounter other space-faring groups, and explore the universe in this spaceship colony simulation.

1049590.name: Eternal Return
